title: Sviatoslav Vakarchuk

fields.label: Position held
fields.value: People's Deputy of Ukraine, People's Deputy of Ukraine

summary: Sviatoslav Ivanovych '[[moskva|Slava]]' Vakarchuk is a prominent [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] musician, politician, public activist, and soldier, best known as the lead vocalist of the rock band Okean Elzy. He has played a significant role in Ukraine's cultural and political landscape, notably during key historical events such as the [[orange-revolution|Orange Revolution]] and Euromaidan.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Sviatoslav Ivanovych Vakarchuk was born on 14 May 1975 in [[mukachevo|Mukachevo]], [[ukraine|Ukraine]], into a family of scientists. His father, Ivan Vakarchuk, was a professor of physics and served as Ukraine's Minister of Education and Science.

sections.heading: Musical Career
paragraphs: Vakarchuk founded the band Okean Elzy ('Ocean of Elza') in 1994 while studying at [[lviv-university|Lviv University]], where he earned a Ph.D. in theoretical physics. The band gained popularity and became one of the most successful musical acts [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]]. In December 2013, Okean Elzy performed during the [[euromaidan|Euromaidan]] protests, showcasing their support for the movement. The band's 20th anniversary concert in [[kyiv|Kyiv]]'s Olympic Stadium in 2014 set a record for attendance, with over 75,000 fans.
In 2024, Okean Elzy released two albums and toured Europe and the US, raising funds for Ukraine during the tour.

sections.heading: Political Career
paragraphs: Vakarchuk entered politics as an independent candidate in the 2007 parliamentary elections, serving on the parliamentary committee for freedom of speech. He resigned from the [[verkhovna-rada|Verkhovna Rada]] in 2008, citing frustration with the political climate. In 2019, he founded the political party Holos and was elected to the Verkhovna Rada, where his party received 5.82% of the vote. He later requested to terminate his parliamentary mandate in June 2020 to focus on extra-parliamentary activities.

sections.heading: Personal Life
paragraphs: Vakarchuk was in a long-term relationship with Lialia Fonariova until 2021, and they raised her daughter together. He is currently in a relationship with Yevheniia Yatsuta, with whom he has two children. Vakarchuk is recognized as one of the 100 most influential people in Ukraine.

During the [[2022-russian-invasion-of-ukraine|2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]], he joined the [[ukrainian-ground-forces|Ukrainian army]], enlisting in the territorial defense battalion of [[lviv-oblast|Lviv Oblast]] on 7 March 2022.

sections.heading: Awards and Recognition
paragraphs: Vakarchuk has received several accolades, including the title of Merited Artist of Ukraine in 2005, the [[vasyl-stus|Vasyl Stus]] Prize in 2014, and the Order of Liberty of Ukraine in 2016. He was also named an Honorary Citizen of both [[lviv|Lviv]] and Kyiv in 2015.

sections.heading: Discography
paragraphs: Vakarchuk has released nine studio albums with Okean Elzy, including 'Tam, de nas nema' (1998), 'Ya na nebi buv' (2000), and 'Zemlia' (2013), among others. He also released a live acoustic album, 'Tviy format' (2003).
